svg.title: TF-IDF and cosine similarity intuition
svg.desc: Shows how storylines become vectors in a word-feature space, and how cosine similarity measures the angle between them

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does TF-IDF convert text to numbers?')
sendPrompt('What does sublinear_tf=True do in TF-IDF?')
sendPrompt('What does the TF-IDF matrix look like?')
sendPrompt('What is a good cosine similarity score for movie recommendations?')
sendPrompt('Why is Movie B recommended as similar to Movie A?')
sendPrompt('Why is Movie C not recommended as similar to Movie A?')
g.text: Movie A vs Movie C → 0.11 (not similar)
